title: Scalable Edge-assisted Fusion and Path Prediction for Connected Autonomous Vehicles
description:
arXiv:2609.04364v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The planning algorithms inside an Autonomous Vehicle (AV) rely on information from on-board sensors whose line of sight is limited by emerging traffic conditions and occlusions.
